task.title: Install the app on your phone and PC
task.shortdesc: Command Centre is a web app you can install: its own icon, full screen, push notifications. On Windows there is also a desktop app that makes the PC a worker.

context.p: Installing is optional, but on an iPhone push notifications only work from an installed app.

step.cmd: Android or Chrome on a PC: choose Install on the Install Command Centre banner, or SettingsInstall app.

info.p: Chrome's own menu works too: ⋮Install app.

step.cmd: iPhone or iPad: open the site in Safari, then ShareAdd to Home Screen.
Windows, as a worker PC: download the desktop app from Devices.

info.p: It is the same app in a window, plus a worker that runs video, GPU and local Claude Code jobs while it is open.

result.p: Then turn on push for this device in Notification settings.

conbody.p: When a new version is deployed, a banner says A new version of Command Centre is ready. Choose Update. Settings shows the version you are on, with Check for updates.
The browser only offers to install a site served over HTTPS with a valid certificate. Check the address shows a padlock.
